messages.subject: Download renderDataTable
parts:
Hey how you doing! i wonder to know how can i download a data table that i previously filtre with some selectInput, this is my code. I wonder to know if you can help me! thanks!!!

ui<-fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Resultados Ranking"),
  
  # Create a new Row in the UI for selectInputs
  fluidRow(
    column(4,
           selectInput("division",
                       "Division:",
                       c("All",
                         unique(as.character(New$Division))))
    ),
    column(4,
           selectInput("jefatura",
                       "Jefatura:",
                       c("All",
                         unique(as.character(New$Jefatura))))
    ),
    column(4,
           selectInput("area",
                       "Area:",
                       c("All",
                         unique(as.character(New$Area))))
    ),
    column(4,
           selectInput("gerencia",
                       "Gerencia:",
                       c("All",
                         unique(as.character(New$Gerencia))))
    ),
    
    downloadButton('downloadData', 'Descargar base')
  ),
  # Create a new row for the table.
  fluidRow(
    DT::dataTableOutput("table")
  )
)

server<-function(input, output) {

  
  
  # Filter data based on selections
  output$table <- DT::renderDataTable(DT::datatable({
 
    tabla1 <- New
    if (input$division != "All") {
      tabla1 <- tabla1[tabla1$Division == input$division,]
    }
    if (input$jefatura != "All") {
      tabla1 <- tabla1[tabla1$Jefatura == input$jefatura,]
    }
    if (input$area != "All") {
      tabla1 <- tabla1[tabla1$Area == input$area,]
    }
    if (input$gerencia != "All") {
      tabla1 <- tabla1[tabla1$Gerencia  == input$gerencia,]
    }
    
 
    
  }))
  
      tabla1<-tabla1
  
  
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    
    filename = function() { paste("Base filtrada",Sys.Date(),".csv",sep=" ") }, 
    content = function(file) {write.csv(tabla1, file)}
  )
  
  
  
}

shinyApp(ui=ui,server=server)
